// diagnostic

E0805

`yield` used outside a function declared `Stream<T>` (D-STREAMYIELD1)

What

`yield` used outside a function declared `Stream<T>` (D-STREAMYIELD1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0805

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0805: tests/ui/loop_stream_reuse.stderr.

Error [E0805]: `yield` outside a generator
  --> tests/ui/loop_stream_reuse.jet:4:9
    |
  4 |         yield i
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: `yield` hands a value to a `Stream<T>` consumer — only a function declared `Stream<T> ->` may use it
 Fix: declare `Stream<T> ->` on this function, or remove the `yield`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0805

Error [E0121]: `s` was given away earlier, so it can't be used here
  --> tests/ui/loop_stream_reuse.jet:12:15
    |
 12 |     loop x in s -> print("{x}")
    |               ^
 Why: after a value moves to another name, the old name no longer gives access to it
 Fix: `s` is one-pass and cannot be copied — create a fresh source for the second drive
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0121

Error [E0107]: nothing named `x` exists here
  --> tests/ui/loop_stream_reuse.jet:12:28
    |
 12 |     loop x in s -> print("{x}")
    |                            ^
 Why: a name must be declared before it's used
 Fix: did you mean `s`?
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0107
